lines.say: Homemakers, four steps to sell your tiffin recipes. Step two is the best one.
lines.card: Frame 0: the finished 12-page tiffin-recipe PDF open on a phone, tagged EXAMPLE. Title 120px or more: 4 STEPS. #2 IS THE ONE (the '#2' in the accent italic). Ranked list card peeks in below with 4 empty dashed rows, row 2 carrying a favourite star.

lines.say: Step one: pick what you already cook.
lines.show: Step 1: pick what you already cook.
lines.card: STEP 1 of 4. Input card: a recipe notebook with 3 rows ticking in: Poha, Veg paratha roll, Sprout chaat. Chip: KIDS' TIFFIN.

lines.say: Step two: speak recipes into the Claude app, get a clean guide.
lines.show: Step 2: speak it, get a clean guide.
lines.card: STEP 2 of 4, FAVOURITE star. Full-width flow that builds piece by piece: a voice-note waveform (your words, ink) arrow to an AI box (blue = the AI) arrow to a clean recipe card that types in: Ingredients, Steps 1 to 4, Time: 15 min, Tip for school mornings. Green ticks on each section.

lines.say: Step three: Canva AI lays it out as a PDF.
lines.show: Step 3: Canva AI makes the PDF.
lines.card: STEP 3 of 4. Before/after split: the plain text guide on the left, a laid-out PDF page on the right (cover, recipe page, contents) with a divider wiping across. Small amber chip: FREE PLAN HAS LIMITS.

lines.say: Step four: put it on a sales page, post the link in your family chats.
lines.show: Step 4: Topmate, then your WhatsApp groups.
lines.card: STEP 4 of 4. A product listing card (title: Tiffin Recipes, 12 pages, price chip ₹99 EXAMPLE) and below it a WhatsApp-style group message row sharing the link in your own family and society groups.

lines.say: Done. Your own recipe book, with a small price, as an example.
lines.show: Your recipes, as a ₹99 guide. EXAMPLE.
lines.card: PAYOFF, full card: the finished 12-page tiffin guide (cover plus two inner pages fanned out), price tag ₹99 stamped EXAMPLE, and one line: Topmate's fee: [VERIFY: copy word for word from Topmate's own pricing page before render]. The completed 4-step ranked list sits beside it with step 2 starred.

lines.say: The catch: first buyers know you, it takes weeks, nothing's guaranteed.
lines.show: The catch: weeks, not days. No guarantee.
lines.card: Amber catch card, 3 rows: First buyers = people who know you. Takes weeks. Nothing is guaranteed.

lines.say: Send this to the sister whose recipes everyone asks for. Comment PRODUCT.
lines.show: Send this. Comment PRODUCT for the plan.
lines.card: End card: 'Save.' in the serif with a bookmark shape, a quiet line 'Send to the didi whose recipes everyone asks for', and a dark pill: Comment PRODUCT. Sticker: FREE WEEKEND PLAN.
